external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Dubravka Dujmović Kušan (Croatian) is an experienced cultural manager and international youth music cooperation professional associated with Jeunesses Musicales Croatia (Hrvatska Glazbena Mladez). Graduate of the Political Sciences Faculty of the University of Zagreb, she has contributed for over 30 years to international initiatives connecting young musicians across Europe and the Mediterranean, including the World Youth Jazz Orchestra, Euro-Mediterranean Youth Music Expo in Limassol and music

Tatiana Tsietti is a Cypriot civil engineer, cultural activist and President of Cultural Movement Epilogi in Limassol. Epilogi is the largest cultural NGO in Limassol with hundreds of members engaged in musical and other cultural activities. Epilogi is member of JM International and European Choral Association – Europa Cantat. Through her long-standing voluntary engagement, she has contributed to community cultural activities, international cooperation and initiatives promoting social inclusion

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Founded in 2012 and based in Limassol, Cyprus, the Euro-Arab Youth Music Center (EAYMC) brings together young people, musicians and cultural organisations from Europe and the Arab world through the universal language of music.

network.coverage_note: The institution is a cultural centre rather than a traditional university or school. No formal list of Erasmus+ partners is provided, only founding partners and network affiliations.
